purpose: Three-layer quantitative positioning. Layer A (external_reported) records what published systems reported under THEIR OWN benchmarks. Layer B (internal_motar) records MOTAR's own measured effects, each bound to a result path. Layer C (matched_external) is the only layer in which a cross-system numerical comparison would be legitimate, and it is empty.
prohibited_operations: subtracting an external_reported value from an internal_motar value
expressing any external_reported value as a MOTAR advantage or deficit
moving an entry into matched_external without a preregistered matched-contract run

internal_motar.axis: Target-motion generalization of a frozen policy (H / E0 / E1 / E2)
internal_motar.baseline: Arm H, the historical target lineage the checkpoint was trained on
internal_motar.treatment: E0 static / E1 constant-velocity / E2 obstacle-aware target motion
internal_motar.metric: close-approach rate (capture_rate), seed-paired difference vs H
internal_motar.extra: arm means E0 84.31% < E1 85.07% < H 87.89% < E2 89.22%; E0 vs H -3.58 pp; E1 vs H -2.82 pp; E2 vs E0 +4.91 pp; 48 cells, 98,319 raw episodes, 3 seeds, all contrasts 3/3 seed sign-consistent
internal_motar.limitation: Three evaluation seeds; exact permutation inference cannot reach conventional significance (minimum attainable two-sided p = 0.25), so effect sizes and seed sign-consistency carry the reading, not a significance claim. The preregistered distance primary min_relative_distance_m is NOT_RECORDED. The 5 pp materiality rule used in the preliminary report was NOT preregistered and is withdrawn. One checkpoint, one arena, four densities; simulation only.

matched_external.note: A Class A entry requires the same arena, obstacle layouts, start/target states, target trajectory, success definition, timeout, seeds and episode count. None exists.
